title: Fixed Single Sided Peg and Continuous Warp Band Loom
description: One newly authored complete one-sided narrow-band weaving-frame appearance. Two full crossfeet carry a low longitudinal side frame, a high rear upright, rising side arm and lower brace. Five complete cantilevered round pegs support eight continuous closed warp-appearance circuits around the entire changing-height route. Every route bends around the actual peg surface rather than ending in disconnected straight painted lines. A separate low transverse heddle bar and four whole genuinely open elongated loops occupy the front upper working span. Unlike the old horizontal four-wing warping cage, this is not an axial rotating framework with two end stands; all pegs project from one side and the thread path stays in a vertical plane. Unlike the full treadle floor loom, there are no two end drums, tall two-shaft castle, beater or treadles. No old mesh imported, extracted or scaled. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal whole-bounds-centred ground origin. One whole static prop zero scenes. Generic inkle-inspired display only, not a validated weaving system: no interlacing sequence, shed change, thread movement, tension, textile result, ergonomic suitability, adjustment, manufacture or safe operation. No rigging, animation or interaction.
